title: Add connection monitoring and auto-reconnect to data-objectstack adapter
body:
Implements connection state monitoring, automatic reconnection, and batch operation progress tracking for `@object-ui/data-objectstack`. Updates console to ObjectStack Spec v0.9.0.

## Changes

### @object-ui/data-objectstack

**Connection State Monitoring**
- Added 5-state connection lifecycle: `disconnected` → `connecting` → `connected` | `reconnecting` | `error`
- Event-based subscription via `onConnectionStateChange(listener)`
- Query methods: `getConnectionState()`, `isConnected()`

**Auto-Reconnect**
- Exponential backoff on connection failures (delay × 2^(attempts-1))
- Configurable: `autoReconnect`, `maxReconnectAttempts`, `reconnectDelay`
- Enabled by default with 3 retry attempts

**Batch Progress Events**
- Real-time progress tracking for bulk operations via `onBatchProgress(listener)`
- Emits: operation type, total count, completed/failed counts, completion percentage

### @object-ui/console

- Updated spec compliance from v0.8.2 to v0.9.0
- Dashboard and Page navigation already implemented, documentation updated

## Usage

```typescript
const dataSource = createObjectStackAdapter({
  baseUrl: 'https://api.example.com',
  autoReconnect: true,
  maxReconnectAttempts: 5,
  reconnectDelay: 1000
});

// Monitor connection state
dataSource.onConnectionStateChange(({ state, error }) => {
  if (state === 'error') console.error('Connection failed:', error);
  if (state === 'connected') console.log('Connected to ObjectStack');
});

// Track bulk operation progress
dataSource.onBatchProgress(({ operation, percentage, failed }) => {
  console.log(`${operation}: ${percentage.toFixed(1)}% (${failed} failed)`);
});

await dataSource.bulk('users', 'create', largeDataset);
```

## API Changes

All changes are backward compatible. New features are opt-in via event listeners and configuration parameters.

<summary>Original prompt</summary>

> 4. 数据适配器
> 
> 4.1 @object-ui/data-objectstack (v0.3.1)
> 
> 职责: ObjectStack 服务端数据适配器
> 
> 当前状态:
> 
> ✅ 完整 CRUD 操作 (find, findOne, create, update, delete)
> ✅ 批量操作 (bulk create/update/delete)
> ✅ 元数据获取 (getObjectSchema)
> ✅ LRU 缓存 + TTL 过期机制
> ✅ 全面错误处理 (6种错误类型)
> 与 Spec 对齐:
> 
> // ✅ 实现 @objectstack/client 的完整封装
> import { createObjectStackAdapter } from '@object-ui/data-objectstack';
> 
> const dataSource = createObjectStackAdapter({
>   baseUrl: 'https://api.example.com',
>   token: 'auth-token'
> });
> 
> // ✅ 查询参数转换
> const result = await dataSource.find('users', {
>   filter: { age: { $gt: 18 } },     // ✅ ObjectQL 过滤器
>   sort: { createdAt: -1 },          // ✅ 排序
>   skip: 0,
>   limit: 20
> });
> 缺口:
> 
> ⏳ 连接状态监控和自动重连
> ⏳ 批量操作进度事件
> ⏳ 高级过滤器转换 (joins, subqueries)
> 5. 应用层
> 
> 5.1 @object-ui/console (v0.1.0)
> 
> 职责: ObjectStack 控制台 - 标准运行时 UI
> 
> 当前状态:
> 
> ⚠️ 声明支持 ObjectStack Spec v0.8.2 (需升级到 v0.9.0)
> ✅ 多应用支持 (App switching)
> ✅ 动态 UI 渲染 (Dashboard, Grid, Form)
> ✅ 权限感知导航
> ✅ 应用品牌定制 (logo, colors)
> 与 Spec 对齐:
> 
> // ✅ AppSchema 支持
> import { App } from '@objectstack/spec/ui';
> 
> const app = App.create({
>   name: 'my_app',
>   label: 'My App',
>   icon: 'users',
>   branding: {
>     logo: '/logo.png',
>     primaryColor: '#10B981'
>   },
>   navigation: [...]  // ✅ 支持 object/dashboard/page/url/group
> });
> 缺口:
> 
> ❌ 版本落后 (v0.8.2 → v0.9.0)
> ⏳ Dashboard 导航类型为 "planned"
> ⏳ Page 导航类型为 "planned"
> ⏳ 动态权限检查需要完善
